prs.title: feat(store)!: require an explicit connection for RedisStore
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body:
Connecting to `localhost:6379` by default hid misconfigured deployments until the first job got lost.

BREAKING CHANGE: `new RedisStore()` without `connection` now throws.

prs.title: chore: drop legacy option shims
prs.author: tidewatcher
prs.body: Removes code paths that have been sitting around for a while. Less code, less to maintain.

prs.title: feat(retry): add exponential jitter strategy
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body:
Opt in with `backoff: { type: 'jitter', baseMs }`. Helps against retry storms.

Closes #388

prs.title: fix(worker): honor shutdownTimeoutMs during graceful close
prs.author: tidewatcher
prs.body:
`worker.close()` waited for active jobs forever and ignored the option.

Fixes #392

prs.title: chore(worker): deprecate boolean argument of worker.pause()
prs.author: tidewatcher
prs.body: `pause(true)` does not say what it does. The boolean keeps working and warns once.

prs.title: fix(cli): exit non-zero when inspect fails
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body: `quaykit inspect` printed the error and exited with 0.

prs.title: docs: migration guide for v5
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/migrate-v5.md
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+# Migrating to v5
+
+Pass a `connection` to `RedisStore`.

prs.title: ci: publish with provenance
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.diff:

+++ b/.github/workflows/release.yml
@@ -20,1 +20,1 @@

prs.title: refactor(store): extract key builder
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body: Pure move, shared with the Postgres store.

issues.title: Retry storms after an outage
issues.body: All failed jobs come back at the same moment and knock the service over again.

issues.title: worker.close() hangs on deploy
issues.body: A stuck job keeps the process alive until the orchestrator kills it.
